cards.ex: He finally owned up to breaking the vase.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat vazani sindirganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan xatoni yoki aybni tan olish, bo'yniga olmoq.

cards.ex: He took the rap for his friend to save him from trouble.
cards.exUz: U do'stini muammodan qutqarish uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birovning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: Luckily, the evidence got him off the hook.
cards.exUz: Yaxshiyamki, dalillar uni javobgarlikdan ozod qildi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikdan yoki jazodan qutulish, ozod bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's up to you to decide what to do next.
cards.exUz: Keyingi nima qilishni hal qilish senga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish javobgarligi sening zimangda.

cards.ex: Someone has to take the fall for this mistake.
cards.exUz: Bu xato uchun kimdir javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birovning xatosi uchun javobgarlikka tortilish.

cards.ex: He's always trying to shirk responsibility.
cards.exUz: U har doim javobgarlikdan qochishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikdan qochish yoki uni bajarishdan bosh tortish.

cards.ex: They laid the blame at the government's door.
cards.exUz: Ular aybni hukumatga yuklashdi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdor deb hisoblash, aybni biror kimga yoki nimagadir yuklash.

cards.ex: It was a lapse in judgment, and I regret it.
cards.exUz: Bu xato qaror edi va men bundan afsusdaman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki ahmoqona qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The company's finances are under scrutiny.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyasi diqqat ostida.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy tekshiruv va kuzatuv ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company will foot the bill for your travel expenses.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya sizning sayohat xarajatlaringizni qoplaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni to'liq qoplab berish.

cards.ex: If things go wrong, I'll be the one to carry the can.
cards.exUz: Agar ishlar noto'g'ri ketsa, men javobgarlikni zimmasiga olaman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birovning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq, noxush natijalarni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: He was found culpable in the accident.
cards.exUz: U baxtsiz hodisada aybdor deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdor yoki xatoga yo'l qo'ygan.

cards.ex: Managers are accountable for their team's performance.
cards.exUz: Rahbarlar o'z jamoasining ishlashi uchun javobgardir.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa uchun javobgar bo'lish, hisobot berish kerak bo'lgan.

cards.ex: Don't fob me off with excuses!
cards.exUz: Meni bahonalar bilan aldama!
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qoniqarsiz javob bilan aldash yoki qochish.

cards.ex: His explanation didn't pass muster with the investigators.
cards.exUz: Uning tushuntirishi tergovchilarning talablariga javob bermadi.
cards.uzDef: Tekshiruvdan o'tish, talablarga javob berish.

cards.ex: He was let off with a warning.
cards.exUz: U ogohlantirish bilan ozod qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Jazolamasdan ozod qilish yoki yengilroq jazo berish.

cards.ex: The company is on the hook for the damages.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya zararlar uchun javobgardir.
cards.uzDef: Javobgar yoki mas'ul bo'lish.

cards.ex: He tried to shift the blame onto his colleague.
cards.exUz: U aybni hamkasbiga o'tkazishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aybni boshqa birovga o'tkazishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His career hangs in the balance after the scandal.
cards.exUz: Uning martabasi janjaldan keyin xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Natija noaniq, xavf ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Politicians should be held to account for their promises.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar o'z va'dalari uchun javobgar bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xatti-harakatlari uchun javobgar bo'lish va jazolanish xavfi bor.

cards.ex: Small businesses will bear the brunt of the new regulations.
cards.exUz: Kichik bizneslar yangi qoidalarning eng katta zarbasini o'ziga oladi.
cards.uzDef: Eng katta zararni yoki og'irlikni o'ziga olmoq.

cards.ex: The responsibility rests with the manager to ensure safety.
cards.exUz: Xavfsizlikni ta'minlash menejerning zimmasida.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlik aynan shu odam yoki tashkilot zimmasida.

cards.ex: If you leave him to his own devices, he'll just watch TV all day.
cards.exUz: Agar uni o'z holiga tashlab qo'ysangiz, u kun bo'yi televizor ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xohishiga ko'ra ish qilishga ruxsat berish (ko'pincha salbiy ma'noda).

cards.ex: The company was found negligent in its safety procedures.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya xavfsizlik tartib-qoidalarida e'tiborsiz deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborsiz, beparvo, o'z vazifasini bajarmagan.

cards.ex: The guard was derelict in his duty and fell asleep.
cards.exUz: Qorovul o'z vazifasida e'tiborsiz bo'lib uxlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z vazifasini bajarmagan yoki e'tiborsiz bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The company faces potential liability for the accident.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya baxtsiz hodisa uchun potentsial javobgarlikka duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki moliyaviy javobgarlik.

cards.ex: He may have had a hand in the fraud.
cards.exUz: U firibgarlikda ishtirok etgan bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada ishtirok etmoq, ayniqsa, yashirin yoki noqonuniy.

cards.ex: He finally came clean about his past.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat o'z o'tmishi haqida rostini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida rostini aytish, tan olish.

cards.ex: His job is on the line if he fails again.
cards.exUz: Agar u yana muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa, uning ishi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida bo'lish, yo'qotish ehtimoli bo'lish.

cards.ex: How do you account for the missing money?
cards.exUz: Yo'qolgan pulni qanday tushuntirasiz?
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir sababini tushuntirish yoki izoh berish.
